content.short: MEXC is a global crypto exchange known for fast listings and low fees on spot and futures.
content.description: MEXC is a global cryptocurrency exchange offering spot and futures trading on a very wide range of tokens, known for listing new projects quickly and for low trading fees. Stable's official ecosystem page lists MEXC among its exchange partners.
